title: Wathay Ferenc összes műve (Complete works of Ferenc Wathay)
author: Ferenc Wathay
institution: Eötvös Loránd University (ELTE), Budapest; edited by Csilla Tóth and Tünde Tóth
region: Hungary (written in Ottoman captivity at Constantinople)
notes: Network critical edition of the songbook ('Enekes könyv') of Ferenc Wathay, written while he was held in the Black Tower at Constantinople: title page, preface and 28 songs in a letter-faithful transcription, with facsimile pages and an afterword. Count is our own: about 21,700 words in the 'bhu' transcription pages (title, preface, songs 1-28). Status archived: pages date from 1999-2000 and the site's files show no change after September 2023.
